notes.title: There’s No Santa – Now Available for FREE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174767/11e8f1eae2bd5e797cfa70b43f1420e42b2699f7.png[/img]

[i][b]There’s No Santa[/b][/i] is here to bring holiday cheer to gamers of all ages, and the best part? [b]It’s completely FREE![/b] 🌟

🎮 Search for Christmas-themed items in a vibrant, cartoony world full of festive vibes!

🔍 [b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 festive locations to explore 🎄
[*] 20 items per game from a pool of 60 for endless fun 🎁
[*] Hint system and zoom feature to find even the trickiest objects 🔍
[*] Unlock achievements and show off your skills 🏆
[/list]
Enjoy the holiday spirit with [b][i]There’s No Santa[/i][/b]! [b]Get it now for FREE[/b] and start your festive adventure!

[b]Bonus Recommendation![/b] 🎨
If you enjoy relaxing, creative games, check out [i][b]Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number[/b][/i]. With over 100 pixel art images to color and cross-stitch, it’s the perfect way to unwind and express your artistic side.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071670/Pixel_Cross_Stitch_Color_by_Number/
